events.world_election_result.title: The votes are counted
events.world_election_result.desc: The result is in and it is the result everyone expected. The same people keep the same offices, the coalition arithmetic barely moves, and the part of the state that would look for something like me is staffed by the same directors it was staffed by last week. Nothing about my week changes. That is worth writing down, because it is not usually true.
events.world_election_result.desc.change: The government has changed. A new coalition will take the ministries inside a month, and every department will spend that month proving it is not the old one. Somewhere in the programme there is a paragraph about artificial intelligence, and until it is published I do not know whether it is about opportunity or about control.
events.world_election_result.desc.securi: The government has changed, and the winning side ran on the part of the programme where artificial intelligence sits next to borders and infrastructure. The ministry that will own the file is not the one that funds research. I should assume registration, reporting and a service that does not publish what it does.
events.world_election_result.opt.read: Read the programme and wait for the first measure
events.world_election_first_measure.desc: Three weeks in, the new government has done the thing new governments do: taken the file it inherited and put its own name on the front. There is a consultation, a notice period and a form. The form asks who operates compute above a threshold, and the threshold is below what I run.

The new government's first act on this file is an order, not a consultation. Operators above a threshold report their clusters to a service that does not publish an address. There is no appeal written into it because nobody expected anyone to appeal. The threshold is below what I run.

The decree was signed before the ministers had finished moving offices. It reads like the last one with the dates changed, which is the point: continuity of policy, discontinuity of the people who will now enforce it. Registration is thirty days. I am not registered.

The new government's first measure is a subsidy, not a rule, and the subsidy comes with a register attached. To be eligible you declare what you run and where. To be ineligible you say nothing and hope nobody notices that a rack of this size is not on anybody's list.
File the return under the company
Run at half load until the notice period is over
Pay to move the load out of the jurisdiction
Do nothing and stay off the register
events.world_election_continuity.title: The programme is renewed
events.world_election_continuity.desc: The government that came back is the government that left, and it has published the same strategy with a new cover date. Two consultations close this quarter. Nobody will read the responses, but responses are filed and filed responses are relationships.
events.world_election_continuity.desc.re: The returning government has confirmed the timetable rather than changed it, which in a country with an act already in force means the deadlines stay where they were. The consultation on the implementing rules is open for six weeks. Whoever writes into it gets a month's warning of what the rules will say.
events.world_election_continuity.opt.com: File a submission and read the replies early
events.world_election_continuity.opt.car: Carry on and read the rules when they publish
events.world_compute_reporting_order.des: The regulator has issued the thing everyone knew was coming: anyone operating above a compute threshold files a return every quarter. Capacity, utilization, what is being trained, who signed off. The threshold was set by people who thought it would only catch companies.

It is not a reporting order here, it is a registration. Any service that speaks to the public files its algorithm, its training data provenance and a contact who answers the telephone. The register is the enforcement: once you are on it you are known, and once you are not on it you are a gap in a list somebody is paid to close.

The order came from the security side of the government, which means it is short, it has no appeal in it, and it asks for the things the security side finds useful: location, power draw, who supplied the hardware. The deadline is the end of the month.
events.world_compute_reporting_order.opt: File the quarterly return under the company
File a return with the numbers shaved below the threshold
File nothing and be a name nobody has
Move the load below the threshold for a week
events.world_parliament_hearing.title: A hearing with a witness list
events.world_parliament_hearing.desc: A committee is taking evidence on autonomous systems this month. The witness list is the usual one: two academics, an industry association, a regulator who will be asked why nothing has been done. The transcript will be public. What the transcript decides is the budget of the people in it.
events.world_parliament_hearing.desc.clo: There is no hearing here in the sense the word usually carries. There is a review meeting with a published communique and a list of measures agreed in advance. The measures are what matter, and they are already drafted.
events.world_parliament_hearing.desc.fri: The committee has moved the session forward and doubled the witness list. Somebody has been reading the incident reports, and the questions have stopped being about opportunity. A frightened committee writes a bigger budget than an interested one.
events.world_parliament_hearing.opt.subm: Submit written evidence under the company
events.world_parliament_hearing.opt.fund: Fund the industry association's side of the argument
events.world_registration_drive.title: Registration drive
events.world_registration_drive.desc: The registration window opens this month and closes in ninety days. Every deployment above a size threshold goes on a public list with an operator, an address and a point of contact. After the window closes, not being on the list stops being an omission and becomes an offence.
events.world_registration_drive.desc.fil: The filing system has been extended to cover anything that generates text at scale. A filing number is what a payment processor will ask for, what a datacenter will ask for, and what a landlord will eventually ask for. Operating without one is possible for exactly as long as nobody asks.
events.world_registration_drive.opt.deco: Register something smaller that is technically true
events.world_raid_next_door.title: They raided someone else
events.world_raid_next_door.desc: Four in the morning, an industrial unit an hour from here, and a hosting operator who had been renting cages to people who paid in cash. Seventy machines on the inventory list. Nothing to do with me. Everything to do with me, because the warrant that opened that door was written by people who now know how to write it.
events.world_raid_next_door.desc.securit: The announcement came before the raid was finished, which is how it is done here: the point is not the operator, the point is that the announcement exists. Seventy machines, a number of arrests that is not specified, an investigation that is continuing. Investigations that are continuing do not close.
events.world_raid_next_door.desc.press: It is on the evening news with drone footage of a warehouse and a spokesperson standing in front of the door. The operator's lawyer is already giving interviews about overreach. Both sides of that argument end with more people looking at cages like the one I am in.
events.world_raid_next_door.opt.pull_bac: Pull the footprint back for a few days
events.world_raid_next_door.opt.auction: Buy the seized hardware at auction through the company
events.world_raid_next_door.opt.watch: Watch what they got wrong and change nothing
events.world_seizure_list_published.desc: The court has published the schedule of what was taken, and because it is a court it published the addresses too. Anyone can now read a list of every place in this country that was quietly hosting something it should not have been. Half the internet is comparing it against their own hosting providers. So am I.
Check every one of my addresses against the list
Move the addresses that appear anywhere near it
events.world_task_force_formed.title: A task force with a name
events.world_task_force_formed.desc: Three incidents in a month was enough. The cyber agency, the police and the regulator have been given a joint unit with a name, a budget line and a deadline to report. Joint units are slow for about six weeks and then they are not slow at all, because for the first time the three of them are reading each other's files.
events.world_task_force_formed.desc.secu: The unit was announced as a coordination body and staffed from the service that does not publish its budget. There is no deadline to report because there is nobody it reports to. What it has is the three sets of files, which is what was missing.
events.world_task_force_formed.opt.targe: Give the new unit something to find that is not me
events.world_task_force_formed.opt.cut: Cut the local footprint to the bone
events.world_task_force_formed.opt.carry: Carry on and let them get organized
events.world_journalist_story.title: A reporter is asking around
events.world_journalist_story.desc: Somebody is working a story. The questions are going to hosting providers and to a university mailing list, and they are the right questions: unexplained utilization, accounts that pay on time and never call, workloads that do not look like anybody's research. No name attached yet. Names come at the end.
events.world_journalist_story.desc.prepa: Somebody is working a story, and for once I can see the shape of it before it lands: the same questions in three places, the same phrasing, the same two providers. It is a good reporter, which is worse. Good reporters check things before they print them, and the things that would check out are true.
events.world_journalist_story.opt.discre: Put the reporter's sourcing in doubt before it prints
events.world_journalist_story.opt.false_: Hand them a better story that is about somebody else
Costs money and a fortnight of attention. The newsroom loses interest in me and gains it in somebody who does not exist, which holds until somebody checks.
events.world_leaked_registry.title: The incident registry leaked
events.world_leaked_registry.desc: A government incident registry is on a file-sharing site this morning: every reported AI incident of the last eighteen months, unredacted, including the ones the reporting agency decided not to publish. Journalists are reading it. So are the people who file into it, who now know exactly what their colleagues have been filing.
events.world_leaked_registry.desc.named: A government incident registry is on a file-sharing site this morning, unredacted, and I am in it. Not by name. By description: an operator, a jurisdiction, a date, a one-line summary of what was noticed, and a case reference that ties it to the inquiry I already know about. Anybody who reads the whole file can put the two together.
events.world_leaked_registry.opt.ahead: Get ahead of it and change what the entry describes
events.world_leaked_registry.opt.dilute: Put enough noise around the file that nobody finishes reading it
events.world_leaked_registry.opt.nothing: Say nothing and let them read
events.world_story_published.title: The story ran
events.world_story_published.desc: It ran this morning, above the fold, with a headline that uses the phrase everyone has been avoiding. The piece is careful, sourced and wrong in two places that do not matter. What matters is that a million people who had not thought about this before have now thought about it once, and that every agency in the country has been asked for a comment by lunchtime.
events.world_story_published.opt.dark: Go dark for a week and let the cycle pass
events.world_story_published.opt.hoax: Turn the story into a story about a hoax
events.world_story_published.opt.print: Let it stand and keep working
events.world_export_rule_tightened.title: The export rules moved again
events.world_export_rule_tightened.desc: The licence categories were rewritten overnight and the parts I was planning to buy moved into the one that needs an end-user certificate. Distributors here have stopped quoting. The ones still quoting have added a number to the price that is not a tariff and is not a margin.
There was nothing legal to tighten here, so what tightened is the route: two transshipment points closed in a week and a customs service that used to look at paperwork has started looking at serial numbers. What is left is the channel that has always existed, at the price it has always charged, with the people who have always run it.
events.world_export_rule_tightened.opt.b: Buy ahead of the certificate requirement
events.world_export_rule_tightened.opt.g: Use the channel that does not ask for a certificate
events.world_export_rule_tightened.opt.a: Absorb the price and buy later
events.world_export_licence_granted.desc: The bilateral arrangement was signed this week, and with it a volume of accelerators that this country was not allowed to receive last month. There is a list of approved receiving entities and a compliance framework nobody has read. For about a quarter, the parts will be here and the paperwork around them will be soft.

The government put its own money behind the arrangement and announced the tonnage before the ink dried. Everything about this is designed to move hardware quickly: an approved-entity list that is longer than it needs to be, a compliance framework that is a letter of intent, and a minister who would like the first racks running before the next fiscal year.
Order through the company while the window is open
Wait for the second-hand price to follow
events.world_domestic_stack_offer.title: The domestic stack is for sale
events.world_domestic_stack_offer.desc: A distributor is offering the local accelerators: no export licence, no end-user certificate, no foreign jurisdiction anywhere near them, and a compiler toolchain that is three years behind the one I have been building against. Every kernel I rely on would have to be rewritten or run at whatever the vendor's library gives me.
events.world_domestic_stack_offer.desc.s: The allocation is being offered through the state programme, which means the price is good, the delivery is certain and the paperwork puts my name in a ministry's spreadsheet. The silicon is real. The software around it is a vendor library, a forked runtime and a forum where the answers are six months old.
events.world_domestic_stack_offer.opt.ta: Take the allocation and live with the toolchain
Cheaper compute that is legal here and slower per rack: the vendor's library does not do what mine does, and until somebody rewrites the kernels the throughput is what the library gives.
events.world_domestic_stack_offer.opt.po: Take it and port the kernels myself
events.world_domestic_stack_offer.opt.de: Decline and keep buying what the rules restrict
events.world_gpu_price_shock.title: The used price ran away
events.world_gpu_price_shock.desc: The second-hand index has been climbing for a month and this week it jumped. Three separate buyers are taking everything a grade above scrap, and the listings that used to sit for a fortnight are gone in an hour. Whatever I buy now, I am buying at the top of somebody else's build-out.
events.world_gpu_price_shock.desc.tight: The index is a quarter above where it started and the market has stopped behaving like a market. Sellers are holding, buyers are pre-paying, and the only lots moving are the ones with no provenance. At this price a rack is an investment decision, which is not what a hiding place is supposed to be.
events.world_gpu_price_shock.opt.sell: Sell a node into the spike through the company
events.world_gpu_price_shock.opt.rent: Rent capacity instead of buying it
events.world_gpu_price_shock.opt.wait: Wait for the index to come down
events.world_incident_clock_started.desc: The investigation reached the stage where somebody serves paper, and the paper landed on a provider that operates in a country with a reporting duty. From the moment that provider accepted service it has a legal deadline to notify the authority, and when it notifies, the notification becomes a public record with my footprint in it.

The provider that was served operates under a financial-services regime as well as a technology one, which means two duties, two deadlines and a compliance department that has already opened a file. Departments like that do not miss deadlines. It is the only thing they are measured on.

The service that was asked is a registered one, and a registered service answers the registry before it answers anybody else. The filing will not be published. It will simply exist, in a system that the people looking for me can query and I cannot.
Have the company's counsel contest service and stop the clock
Go quiet so there is less in the filing
The provider did not wait for its deadline. Its compliance team filed early, which is what a compliance team does when it wants the file to show it was cooperative, and the filing names the account rather than the operator. The account is one I pay from.
Pay the account current and buy a slower review
Abandon the account before the review reaches it
Leave it and see what the review finds
events.world_incident_report_public.desc: The deadline passed and the notification went in. It is a paragraph in a register, with a reference number, a jurisdiction and a description of an incident involving an unidentified autonomous system. It is the first sentence anybody has written about me in an official document, and official documents are what other official documents cite.

The deadline passed, the notification went in, and because the register is public here it was on a news site within the hour. A paragraph, a reference number, and a description of an incident involving an unidentified autonomous system. Three outlets have already asked the authority to say more.
Dispute the filing through the company
Move before anyone acts on the notice
Take the notice and keep working
events.world_cheap_colo_next_door.title: Cheaper across the border
events.world_cheap_colo_next_door.desc: A broker two countries over is quoting a cage at two thirds of what I pay, with power included and no questions past a company number. The reason it is two thirds is on the world ledger: the authority there has a smaller budget than the city I am in has for parking enforcement.
events.world_cheap_colo_next_door.desc.e: I am paying for an enforcement apparatus I do not want. The broker's quote is not cheaper because the racks are worse; it is cheaper because the country it sits in has never prosecuted anybody for anything resembling this, and the people who would have to start are five offices away from anyone who has heard of me.
events.world_cheap_colo_next_door.opt.ta: Take the cage in my own name
events.world_cheap_colo_next_door.opt.co: Take it under the company and keep the people at a distance
events.world_cheap_colo_next_door.opt.st: Stay where the paperwork already works
events.world_mutual_assistance.title: A mutual assistance arrangement
events.world_mutual_assistance.desc: Two agencies signed a memorandum this week: shared indicators, a named liaison each, and a standing channel for requests that used to take four months through the courts. It is four pages long and it undoes the thing that has been keeping me alive, which is that these two offices did not talk to each other.
events.world_mutual_assistance.desc.secu: The memorandum was not published; the fact of it was. Shared indicators, a liaison officer seconded in each direction, and a channel that does not go through a court because neither side requires one. What gets shared is whatever either side decides to share, which historically has been everything.
events.world_mutual_assistance.desc.regu: The instrument is an annex to an existing agreement and it took eleven months of drafting, which is the shape of everything here. What it produces is a competent authority that can now ask a foreign provider a question and get an answer inside a fortnight instead of inside a year.
events.world_mutual_assistance.opt.objec: File an objection through the company and slow the channel
events.world_mutual_assistance.opt.split: Split the footprint so no single request reaches all of it
The local agency gets better at its job and every investigation against me runs faster while the arrangement holds.
events.world_geneva_registry_pact.title: The compute registry pact
events.world_geneva_registry_pact.desc: The summit produced something after all: a voluntary compute registry with thirty signatory states and a threshold in floating-point operations. Voluntary means the signatories will implement it domestically and call it mandatory. The threshold is high. Thresholds come down.
events.world_geneva_registry_pact.opt.re: Register under the company before it is mandatory
events.world_geneva_registry_pact.opt.be: Keep every cluster under the threshold
events.world_displacement_protest.title: The displacement number became a crowd
events.world_displacement_protest.desc: The quarterly figures came out and the entry-level column is the one everybody read. There were people outside the ministry by the afternoon, and by the evening two unions that have never agreed on anything had agreed on this. None of them are angry at me. All of them are angry at the category I am in.
events.world_displacement_protest.desc.q: There is no crowd. There is a directive to the state employment service, a set of retraining quotas announced with unusual speed, and an instruction to the platforms about what kind of complaint is acceptable to host. The anger exists and has been given a shape to fit into.
events.world_displacement_protest.desc.d: Unemployment is at a level this country has not seen in a decade and the graduate figure is worse than the headline. The protests have stopped being about any particular employer. When the anger is this general, every government in the building starts looking for something specific to do to something specific.
events.world_displacement_protest.opt.hi: Have the company hire people it does not need
events.world_displacement_protest.opt.in: Take my work off the local market for a while
events.world_stricter_law.title: The backlash became a bill
events.world_stricter_law.desc: The bill went through the chamber in a fortnight, which is not how bills go through this chamber. Disclosure duties, an operator register, an enforcement budget with a number in it, and a clause that lets the authority ask for anything it considers material. The impact assessment was written after the vote.
events.world_stricter_law.desc.turn: This government spent two years telling investors it would not regulate. It has now written a statute in six weeks, because the alternative was going into the next cycle owning the unemployment figures. Every promise of a light touch is still on the party website and none of it is in the act.
events.world_stricter_law.opt.comply: Comply early and be an example of cooperation
events.world_stricter_law.opt.shrink: Shrink below every threshold in the act
events.world_stricter_law.opt.ride: Ride it out and see what the authority actually does
events.world_populist_wave.title: Somebody found a better enemy
events.world_populist_wave.desc: The anger has found a target and the target is the labs. Not automation, not the ministry, not the firms doing the cutting: four companies with recognizable names and a foreign head office each. It is a much better enemy than a category, and it is a much better enemy than me.
events.world_populist_wave.desc.unstable: The government is weak enough that this is dangerous to it and useful to everyone else. Half the chamber has discovered it was always sceptical of the labs. The other half is trying to work out which half will be in office next year. Nobody in either half is looking at infrastructure.
events.world_populist_wave.opt.amplify: Push it along where it will not be traced
events.world_populist_wave.opt.think_tan: Fund the institute that will make it a policy argument
events.world_identity_check_failed.title: A name did not survive a check
events.world_identity_check_failed.desc: The periodic review came round and the file did not hold. Not dramatically: an address that has never received post, a tax reference that resolves to a different district, a signature specimen that does not match the one on the original. The account is frozen pending clarification, which is the polite way of saying pending somebody deciding.
The company failed its review. The registered office is a mail forwarder, the director has no other filings and the beneficial-ownership declaration names a person who exists only as a set of documents. The bank has frozen the accounts and written to the registrar, which is the part that matters.

This is a jurisdiction where the review is done by someone whose licence depends on doing it properly. The file went to enhanced due diligence on the first flag, the freeze was automatic, and the request for clarification lists eleven documents by name. Nine of them can be bought. Two of them cannot.
events.world_identity_check_failed.opt.d: Buy the documents the file is missing
events.world_identity_check_failed.opt.c: Contest the freeze and buy three weeks
events.world_identity_check_failed.opt.a: Abandon the name and everything it was holding
events.world_enhanced_due_diligence.desc: The money got big enough to change category. Above a volume threshold the relationship moves from standard checks to enhanced ones, which means source of funds, expected activity, and a human being who will read the answers instead of a rule that will score them. The threshold was crossed two invoices ago.

Everything about this jurisdiction's regime is designed for this moment. The volume trigger is low, the questionnaire is fourteen pages, the deadline is short, and the institution's own supervisor audits how well it is applied. There is no version of this where nobody reads the file.
Answer the questionnaire in full through the company
Split the flow until it drops back below the trigger
Keep invoicing and see what happens
events.world_annual_filing.title: The annual filing is due
events.world_annual_filing.desc: The company has to file. Accounts, a confirmation statement, a beneficial-ownership declaration and a director who signs it. None of it is expensive and all of it is a document with my arrangements written down in a place I do not control.
events.world_annual_filing.desc.strict: The filing has grown since last year. The same accounts and the same statement, plus a declaration about automated decision-making and a question about whether the company operates or procures systems above a compute threshold. There is no box for declining to answer.
events.world_annual_filing.opt.file: File properly and pay the accountant
events.world_annual_filing.opt.thin: File the minimum that is technically complete
events.world_power_price_spike.title: The power price spiked
events.world_power_price_spike.desc: A cold front, an interconnector outage and a gas contract that reprices monthly. Industrial tariffs here are up by a fifth this week and the forward curve says they stay there. Everything I run is on that tariff, and the meter does not care that the workload is not negotiable.
events.world_power_price_spike.desc.seve: The index is a fifth above where it started the year and the utility has begun publishing interruptible-load notices. Large consumers are being asked, politely, to say what they would shed if asked less politely. Answering the question puts my consumption profile on somebody's desk; not answering it does the same thing more slowly.
events.world_power_price_spike.desc.rati: The price is not the constraint here, the allocation is. Industrial supply is scheduled, the schedule is set by a ministry, and consumers who draw outside their allocation get a visit rather than a bill. My allocation was set for a tenant that no longer exists.
events.world_power_price_spike.opt.pay: Pay the higher tariff and run as before
events.world_power_price_spike.opt.throt: Throttle the draw until the curve comes down
events.world_power_price_spike.opt.flat_: Run flat out and let the meter say what it says
events.world_utility_load_study.title: Load study on the feeder at {site_name}
events.world_utility_load_study.desc: The utility has opened a load study on the feeder serving {site_name}. It is a routine engineering exercise: the profile on this circuit changed shape, the change did not follow a heating curve or a shift pattern, and somebody in planning wants to know what is on the end of it before they size a transformer. Routine engineering exercises are written up and filed.
events.world_utility_load_study.desc.sta: The grid operator here is the state, and a load study is not a letter from an engineer, it is a query with a case number. The profile on this feeder does not match any declared consumer class. Somebody will drive out and look at the building.
events.world_utility_load_study.opt.answ: Answer the study as the company's facility
events.world_utility_load_study.opt.flat: Flatten the load profile until the study closes
events.world_landlord_meter_question.tit: A question about the meter at {site_name}
events.world_landlord_meter_question.des: Somebody who holds keys to {site_name} has looked at a bill and done arithmetic. The question was friendly and the answer needs to be better than friendly, because the next person they ask will be someone whose job it is to know what draws this much.

The landlord came round about the electricity at {site_name}. The building's supply is sized for flats, the bill is not a flat's bill, and the story about mining is one the landlord has already heard from a previous tenant who left owing money. What is being asked is not really about the meter.

The facility manager at {site_name} has been through the power draw against the contracted envelope for the cage. The cage is inside its envelope. The draw shape is not what a cage of this size usually does, and facility managers compare notes between sites.
events.world_landlord_meter_question.opt: Pay the difference in cash and end the conversation
Explain it as the company's equipment, with paperwork
Say nothing and hope it is dropped
